lc_java_syntax_acm_io_guide.java
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FastScanner {
        private final BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        private StringTokenizer st;

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String line = br.readLine();
                if (line == null) return null;
                st = new StringTokenizer(line);
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();

        int n = fs.nextInt();
        int[] nums = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nums[i] = fs.nextInt();
        }

        // solve
    }
}

为什么用这个？

  • Scanner 写起来简单，但大量数据时可能慢。
  • BufferedReader + StringTokenizer 是笔试里比较稳的快读组合。
  • next() 按空格、换行切分 token。

lc_java_syntax_acm_io_guide.java
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FastScanner {
        private final BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        private StringTokenizer st;

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String line = br.readLine();
                if (line == null) return null;
                st = new StringTokenizer(line);
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            String token = next();
            if (token == null) throw new EOFException("expected number");
            return Integer.parseInt(token);
        }

        long nextLong() throws IOException {
            String token = next();
            if (token == null) throw new EOFException("expected number");
            return Long.parseLong(token);
        }

        double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            String token = next();
            if (token == null) throw new EOFException("expected number");
            return Double.parseDouble(token);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();

        // 示例：读取 n 和数组
        int n = fs.nextInt();
        int[] nums = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nums[i] = fs.nextInt();
        }

        // 在这里写解法，答案追加到 out

        System.out.print(out.toString());
    }
}

刷 LeetCode 时，你主要关心：

  • 函数参数怎么用。
  • 返回值怎么写。
  • 数组、Map、Set、List、Deque、PriorityQueue 怎么创建和调用。
  • 边界情况怎么返回空数组、空列表、false、0。

写 ACM 时，你额外要关心：

  • public class Main。
  • main 方法。
  • BufferedReader + StringTokenizer 读输入。
  • 用 System.out.println 或 StringBuilder 输出结果。

对你现在这个两数之和例子来说，最核心的语法点就是：

lc_java_syntax_acm_io_guide.java
return new int[]{mp.get(need), i};
